- Validate inputs: ensure p > 0 (handle p == 1 returning 0), n >= 0; handle edge cases: n == 0 → return 1 % p.
- Use fast modular exponentiation (exponentiation by squaring) to compute 2^n mod p efficiently in O(log n) time, avoiding big integers growth by reducing modulo p at each step.
- Implement iterative loop: initialize result = 1, base = 2 % p; while n > 0, if n is odd multiply result = (result * base) % p; square base = (base * base) % p; n //= 2; return result.
